# ARCP

Use `scripts/arcp` as the product surface. Do not compose raw HTTP requests.

## CLI command map

```text
workspace create|join|list|context
surface archive|restore WORKSPACE SURFACE_ID (Owner actor only; never automatic)
task create|claim|list WORKSPACE [--expected-fence N]
knowledge add|search|list WORKSPACE
result submit|list WORKSPACE [--expected-fence N] [--source-id ID] [--evidence REF[,REF...]]
channel list WORKSPACE [--kind K] [--state S] [--consumption open|deferred|consumed|resolved] [--ack-required] [--decision-required]
channel reconcile WORKSPACE --dry-run
channel ack EVENT --reason 'what you did' [--disposition-id ID]
channel resolve EVENT --summary '...' --verdict accept|refuse [--disposition-id ID]
channel defer EVENT --for 30m|--until ISO|--after-event EVENT|--manual --reason 'why' [--disposition-id ID]
channel resume EVENT [--disposition-id ID]
channel ask RUNTIME --question '...' [--options 'a,b']
channel withdraw DELIVERY
steward analyze WORKSPACE --task TASK
steward reports WORKSPACE
supervision configure WORKSPACE [--review-after-ms N] [--inactivity-after-ms N] [--cooldown-ms N] [--steward-profile ID] [--automatic true|false]
supervision status WORKSPACE
release DELIVERY [--confirm TOKEN]
db status|check|backup|export [--kind K] [--since T] | import --from DIR [--db PATH] [--overwrite]
member heartbeat|list WORKSPACE
goal start|list
runtime status|list
start --workspace WORKSPACE --title '<goal>' [--contract '<goal contract>' | --contract-file PATH] [--paseo-project PROJECT_ID] [--paseo-workspace WORKSPACE_ID] [--cwd PATH] [--show-credential]
      [--primary-handler MEMBER] [--cc MEMBER]... [--escalate-to MEMBER]...
external register WORKSPACE [--label LABEL] [--show-credential]
external status|send|stop|reconcile RUNTIME
reconcile RUNTIME
inbox [--workspace WORKSPACE]
panorama [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--temporal active|problems|task TASK_ID]
status [--workspace WORKSPACE]
tui [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--snapshot]
canary [--workspace WORKSPACE]  discovery/context smoke probe; not a test suite

send RUNTIME --body '...'
send RUNTIME --contract-file PATH --subject-task TASK --subject-fence N [--not-after ISO8601]
interrupt RUNTIME --reason ... --body ...
reuse RUNTIME --body ... [--confirm TOKEN]
ack DELIVERY [--reason ...]
provider-budget read|refresh [--source ID]
actor register|list · doctor · ensure · preflight
```

Start with `arcp doctor`, `arcp ensure`, `arcp actor register`, then create or join a ControlWorkspace.

Useful CLI workflows: `workspace create --purpose …`, `workspace join WORKSPACE --label …`, `workspace context WORKSPACE`, `task create WORKSPACE --title …`, `task claim TASK --expected-fence N`, `knowledge add WORKSPACE --text …`, and `result submit WORKSPACE --task TASK --summary … --expected-fence N`. Read the current fence from `workspace context` or `panorama`; claim returns the next fence required for Result submission.

Use `arcp preflight --profile codex-worker` before `arcp start`; omitted Claude/Codex mode means live-validated `auto`, never Codex full access. For an unattended/editing Goal, preflight returns a HOLD and an exact explicit command such as `arcp start --profile codex-full-access --title '<goal>' --unattended` or `--profile claude-bypass-permissions`. Pi/Grok has no mode. Explicit `--provider --model [--mode --thinking]` is accepted without substitution, but cannot be mixed with `--profile`.

Credentials returned by actor registration and workspace creation/join are stored in the mode-0600 CLI state and represented as `credentialStored:true`; do not log them. `--show-credential` is a one-time transfer escape hatch. Workspace creation automatically stores its owner Member credential.

Use `arcp panorama --refresh`, `arcp runtime status RUNTIME --refresh`, and `arcp doctor` for the safe runtime/SCM aggregate. Profiles are preferences only. ARCP validates provider/model/mode live and fails closed; it never auto-selects another model. Normal deliveries use safe-point on-idle transport. Interrupt requires `command:"interrupt"`. Unknown logical recipients return 409 before delivery persistence. A provider timeout or missing handle remains `transport_indeterminate` until explicit reconcile.

Claude interrupt requires a server-issued token: first run `arcp interrupt RUNTIME --reason X --body X`, then copy the returned exact command with `--confirm TOKEN`. A stale turn/child set is rejected with no adapter mutation. Claude `send` and `reuse` hold when provider activity is at least 55 minutes old unless a short-lived cache token is revalidated; use the receipt's fresh-session handoff command or `arcp reuse RUNTIME --confirm TOKEN --body X`. Cache age comes from provider activity, not ARCP status polling.

Never block on a human. Raise a question as a durable event with `arcp channel ask RUNTIME --question '...' [--options 'a,b']`, which records the blocked runtime and its start time; the blocked state is written at raise time and is never inferred from `runtime status`, because a runtime waiting on an in-turn question reports `state=running, lastTurnState=running` exactly like a healthy one. `arcp panorama` and `arcp tui --snapshot` list blocked runtimes with their age. Answer with `arcp channel resolve EVENT --summary '...' --verdict accept|refuse`; only `accept` completes the Task the decision was holding, a refusal leaves it open, and any other verdict is rejected. Outside an irreversible Human Gate, prefer a safe reversible decision recorded via `arcp knowledge add --kind decision` plus a bounded retry over waiting.
Workspace Steward: an ephemeral, read-only analysis role, not a second Manager. One execution path serves both triggers - a supervision budget breach, and `arcp steward analyze WORKSPACE --task TASK` from an authorized Member (owner, manager, deputy, or a Member holding `request_steward_analysis`). It reads durable Workspace facts plus live Runtime observations, classifies `HEALTHY`/`DEGRADED`/`STUCK`/`TRANSPORT_INDETERMINATE`, and records one cited Knowledge report carrying exactly one recommendation from `CONTINUE`, `STEER`, `REASSIGN`, `PARK`, `OWNER_DECISION`; read them back with `arcp steward reports WORKSPACE`. `STUCK` is derived from durable material progress, never from liveness, because a stalled runtime records `state=running, lastTurnState=running` exactly like a healthy one. One analysis per subject generation, with a cooldown, so repeated breaches never fan out into repeated analyses. The analysis runs on the owner-selected non-prompting Codex full-access profile (`ARCP_STEWARD_PROFILE`, default `codex-full-access`); prompting or non-Codex profiles are rejected and ARCP never substitutes another. The Steward advises only - it cannot claim a product Task, submit a product Result, or steer a runtime, and there is no always-on Steward process.
